items.title: Design your professional portfolio with AI
items.description: Describe who you are, what you create and which brands you work with. Miiles builds your portfolio with templates made for content creators, UGC creators, designers and freelancers, and publishes it with your own link.
bullets: Portfolio templates for UGC creators, editors and freelancers.
Edit text, photos and colors with a prompt, no coding needed.
Publish with your own link, ready to send to brands.

items.title: Create, edit and animate your content
items.description: 60+ assets for video editing, animation and motion graphics: carousels, animated text, transitions and effects in vertical format for Reels, TikTok and Shorts. Everything you need to speed up your creative process.
bullets: 9:16 video components for Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts.
Animated text, transitions and motion graphics ready to use.
Copy the prompt and build the animation with your AI: Claude, Codex, Gemini or Cursor.

items.title: Design business models with the power of AI
items.description: Connect Miiles to Claude or the AI you already use. It works like a skill: your assistant builds your boards, structures your business model and manages your clients, campaigns and income for you.
bullets: Connects with Claude, Codex, Gemini, Cursor and other AI tools.
Boards with clients, campaigns, contracts and income from a single conversation.
AI Business Model Canvas to validate and scale your project.

items.title: Co-create and connect in real time
items.description: Invite your team to work on the same canvas. See connected users’ avatars and edit together without conflicting changes.
bullets: Interactive visual presence with stacked avatars in the header.
Instant synchronization of movements, colors, and connectors.
Quick sharing through public viewing URLs.

items.title: Infinite canvas, complete customization
items.description: Structure your ideas without physical limits. Connect any shapes using bidirectional handles and navigate with a wide zoom range from 5% to 400%.
bullets: Curved connectors with editable text labels in the middle.
Quickly disconnect nodes by dragging from their left half.
Customizable geometric shapes in vibrant brand colors.

phrases: Create a sales funnel for my online course...
